cli_config_about: Validate atlas.yaml, print its JSON Schema or set the display language
cli_config_check_about: Validate atlas.yaml (+ atlas.local.yaml); prints OK or every error, exit 1 on errors
cli_config_lang_about: Show or set the display language (en, pt-BR); `ATLAS_LANG` overrides it per command
cli_config_lang_arg_json: Print JSON (language, source, preference, supported); machine output is never translated
cli_config_lang_arg_tag: Language to save in ~/.atlas/language (en, pt-BR); omit to show the current one
cli_config_lang_arg_unset: Remove the saved language: follow the system language
cli_config_schema_about: Print the JSON Schema for atlas.yaml to stdout
